headings.styles: Tight tracking (tracking-tight), font-bold to font-extrabold. No generic sans.

body.styles: Technical, clean, highly legible for dense data arrays. Regular to Medium weights.

colors.palette_strategy: Vibrant Play / Soft Utility variant constrained to Sky Blue & Slate. NO GREEN.
rules: NO GREEN ALLOWED per user instruction. Use Sky Blue for success states.
The 'Tinted Grey' Rule: Pure grey/black is banned. Use Tailwind Slate.
Never use full-screen gradients. Keep backgrounds solid and highly readable.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-slate-200. Keep it crisp, no thick borders.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle ambient shadows: shadow-sm for cards, shadow-md for dropdowns. Avoid heavy drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.radii: max 8px (rounded-lg) for panels, 4px (rounded) for internal inputs/buttons. Keeps the UI professional and dense.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat Solid surfaces for data visibility. NO GLASSMORPHISM. NO TRANSPARENT BACKGROUNDS for headers, dropdowns, or overlays. Always set solid background (bg-white).

components.tables: Dense, scannable. Cardless layout preferred. Left-align data. Striped or subtle border-b on rows.
components.buttons: Slightly rounded (rounded-md). Clear hover state darkening. Primary actions use Sky Blue.
components.inputs: Shadcn standards. border-slate-200, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-sky-500. No native HTML form elements.
components.navigation: Sidebar for Admin, Topbar or sidebar for Agent. Must be solid bg-slate-900 for contrast or bg-white with a hard border-b/border-r.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_mode_b: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Use h-full so widgets stretch.
grids_and_layouts.agent_workspace: Focus on 'Today Calls'. Pipeline kanban or dense data table split layout.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Compact for data components (p-3 to p-4). Generous for macro layout (p-6 to p-8 padding on main views).

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on interactive elements. transition: transform 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease.
motion.loading: Skeleton loaders matching the shape of data. No generic spinners.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Sky blue against white must meet 3:1 for large UI, 4.5:1 for text.
accessibility.testing: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
accessibility.focus: High contrast rings on focus for all inputs and buttons.

media.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for a professional, technical aesthetic.

login_background.description: Abstract geometric sky blue background for the login screen.

instructions_to_main_agent.file_type: Create and modify .js and .jsx files ONLY. Do NOT use .tsx.
instructions_to_main_agent.ui_library: Use shadcn/ui components extensively. Customize the classes directly in the component file to match the flat, dense styling.
instructions_to_main_agent.charts: Use Recharts for the Reports & Dashboards layer. Ensure axes and lines use Slate colors.
instructions_to_main_agent.forms: Use Shadcn components for forms. Date pickers must use Shadcn Calendar.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic AI outputs. Use specific font families (Manrope & IBM Plex Sans).
Never center-align the app container. Text should flow naturally left-aligned.
CRITICAL: Do not use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, overlays, or sticky headers. ALWAYS use solid bg-white.
CRITICAL: Add `data-testid` to EVERY interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, table row actions).
Use Phosphor icons. Do not use AI emojis for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations without using 'transition-all'.
Respect the NO GREEN rule completely. Use Sky Blue for success and positive states.
